items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: So I think that I was on her first hit — it wasn’t her first record but the first hit — and then her last.

ctx.x: She was singing very well. She loved to sing. So I think that I was on her first hit — it wasn’t her first record but the first hit — and then her last.
That’s wonderful. Can you tell me about Roland Kirk, a little bit about him?
